## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: mixed internals — Materials, Healthcare and Industrials strong vs Technology and Communication weak; Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Materials lead: DD (1W: +187.38% | 1M: +178.61%) ABOVE TREND; Industrials strong: CAT (1W: +10.58% | 1M: +16.34%) ABOVE TREND; Healthcare robust: ABBV (1W: +9.90% | 1M: +14.09%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology lagging: AAPL (1W: -7.03% | 1M: -10.76%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -6.88% | 1M: -15.19%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -4.35% | 1M: -8.79%) BELOW TREND; Communication and Consumer Discretionary also showing weakness with NFLX (1W: -7.87% | 1M: -19.14%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: DD (1W: +187.38% | 1M: +178.61%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +12.66% | 1M: +46.85%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +10.58% | 1M: +16.34%) ABOVE TREND, ABBV (1W: +9.90% | 1M: +14.09%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +9.72% | 1M: +7.57%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5); style mixed / no clear leadership.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: NFLX (1W: -7.87% | 1M: -19.14%) BELOW TREND, BLK (1W: -8.08% | 1M: -9.28%) BELOW TREND, PFE (1W: -8.68% | 1M: -8.43%) BELOW TREND, FCX (1W: -9.06% | 1M: -2.42%) BELOW TREND, NEM (1W: -9.77% | 1M: -14.37%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in episodic Media, select Financials and some Materials names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W momentum: DD (1W: +187.38% | 1M: +178.61%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +12.66% | 1M: +46.85%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +10.58% | 1M: +16.34%) ABOVE TREND; no evidence of a Major Divergence pattern across mega-caps, trends are broadly confirmed.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology is soft with sector 1W -2.62%; mega-caps AAPL (1W: -7.03% | 1M: -10.76%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -6.88% | 1M: -15.19%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -4.35% | 1M: -8.79%) BELOW TREND — watch for further dispersion between AI-linked names (AMAT ABOVE TREND) and enterprise/software weak spots (ORCL (1W: -16.93% | 1M: -21.03%) BELOW TREND).

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials mixed: JPM (1W: +0.50% | 1M: +9.25%) ABOVE TREND while BLK (1W: -8.08% | 1M: -9.28%) BELOW TREND and CME (1W: -10.91% | 1M: -19.95%) BELOW TREND; sector 1W -0.33% indicating idiosyncratic risk and selective opportunities.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare constructive: UNH (1W: +4.00% | 1M: +10.89%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +4.56% | 1M: +6.39%) ABOVE TREND, TMO (1W: +9.54% | 1M: +12.96%) ABOVE TREND — sector 1W +3.61% and showing durable leadership.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor exposure to Materials and Healthcare leaders (DD, ABBV, TMO) and selective Industrials (CAT); reduce exposure to large-cap Technology/Communication names showing confirmed BELOW TREND (AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL). Monitor Financial idiosyncrasies (JPM strength vs CME/BLK weakness).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: AMAT (1W: +12.66% | 1M: +46.85%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +10.58% | 1M: +16.34%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +4.00% | 1M: +10.89%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: ORCL (1W: -16.93% | 1M: -21.03%) BELOW TREND, NFLX (1W: -7.87% | 1M: -19.14%) BELOW TREND, CME (1W: -10.91% | 1M: -19.95%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Materials (1W +16.20%) and Healthcare (1W +3.61%) — breadth positive; BEARISH: Technology (1W -2.62%) and Communication — watch for further downside or stabilization.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch whether AMAT holds its 1W gains to confirm ABOVE TREND continuation; AAPL/MSFT must reclaim near-term selling momentum to signal stabilization; a breakdown in UNH or JNJ would warn broader risk-off despite Materials strength.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
UNH (+50): New AI cost-cutting/dividend focus — UNH (1W: +4.00% | 1M: +10.89%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. LLY (+55): Positive Phase 3 Jaypirca results — LLY (1W: +1.41% | 1M: +5.91%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
GOOGL (-45): Talent losses to Anthropic/OpenAI — GOOGL (1W: -5.52% | 1M: -11.56%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed. CME (-50): Target cut and outlook concern — CME (1W: -10.91% | 1M: -19.95%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL; style mixed / no clear leadership. Materials and Healthcare are showing strength — DD (1W: +187.38% | 1M: +178.61%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +12.66% | 1M: +46.85%) ABOVE TREND, ABBV (1W: +9.90% | 1M: +14.09%) ABOVE TREND. Key risk is broad Tech weakness (AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL BELOW TREND) and confirmed negative sentiment on select Financials (CME) — monitor for spillover.
